name: io.github.mordor-forge/trident-mcp
title: Trident (Tripo 3D)
description: Unofficial MCP server for the Tripo 3D API: text/image to 3D, texturing, rigging, conversion

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Host directory that receives generated meshes, images and splats (one folder per task), mounted at /output in the container. Local input files must live under a mounted directory too.

host_output_dir.description: Absolute path of a host directory for generated models (for example /home/you/generated_models).

runtimeArguments.name: -e
runtimeArguments.description: Tripo API key from https://platform.tripo3d.ai (starts with tsk_). Use your own key; Tripo's terms forbid sharing it.

runtimeArguments.name: -e
runtimeArguments.description: Tripo API host. China-region keys need https://openapi.tripo3d.com/v3.
